_meta.description: ILM for slm-requests-* (daily SLM inference request telemetry shipped by slm_server, FRE-411). No rollover (date-partitioned, no write-alias). Retention: 30d, matching the application-log policy and the elasticsearch_logs RETENTION_POLICIES entry. No warm/forcemerge phase: the 30d retention is short, and any warm min_age >= delete min_age causes ES 400 phase-monotonicity error (FRE-1036 trap). Authored in FRE-1106.
